checked_scope: The Hilbert-space contraction argument, mean-shift interpretation, and Vandermonde identification of bounded reasoning depth.
checks: Jensen and conditional-expectation contraction give ||T||≤1 on the assumed closed field space; the Neumann series and tower/Fubini identities yield Eā=Eθ̄/(1−α).

Applying the mean identity separately at intervention values proves the unconditional shift multiplier without differentiating changing information operators; the Gaussian conditional coefficient λ/(1−αλ) describes a different contrast.
